[This is a second-price (pay the highest other bid) sealed-bid auction. In such auctions, bidding your true private value is a weakly dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit while avoiding cases of overpaying. There is no past history to learn from and values are independent. Ties are resolved randomly but do not change that truthful bidding is optimal. Therefore I will bid my true value of $33. ]

[This is a Vickrey (second-price) auction where the winner pays the highest other bid. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy, maximizing expected surplus. No prior history to exploit. To maximize long-run profit (and this one-round payoff), I will bid my true private value of $31.0, ensuring I win whenever opponents bid below 31 and pay the highest other bid.]
